member.name: T:Blobject.NFS.NfsBlobClient
member.summary: BLOB client for NFSv3 exports, backed by OpenNFS. Keys map to paths within the export, using '/' as the separator. Folders are created on demand when writing, a key ending in '/' refers to a folder, and enumeration returns files and folders, with each folder (IsFolder true, key ending in '/') returned after its contents.
